versions.content: IOControl DID authentication check On reception of the UDS Service InputOutputControlByIdentifier (0x2F), the Dcm shall check if the control ac- cess to the requested DID is authenticated and control the IO only if: • a DcmDspDidControlRole is configured for that DID and the verification according to [SWS_Dcm_01522] was successful or • the active white list on that connection has for the requested DID one entry with control access that matches that DID.
